commit.message: Use compile-time conditionals instead of a runtime function

Separate the Windows stack-growth guard page from StackYellowPages

The default value of StackYellowPages is currently 3 on Windows and 2 on
other OSes, since Windows needs the additional page for its OS-managed
stack-growth guard.  However, this guard page is an implementation
detail rather than part of HotSpot's configured yellow zone.

This patch simplifies the definition and references to the
`DEFAULT_STACK_YELLOW_PAGES` constant by initializing it to 2 on both
AArch64 and x86 for all operating systems and by introducing
`uses_stack_growth_guard_page()` as an OS-specific property to account
for the additional Windows page.

Validated this patch by running through all Tier 1 through 3 HotSpot,
JDK, and langtools tests on both Windows/x64 and Windows/ARM64 builds.
